findings.summary: Runtime dependency graph is not locked in the reviewed source tree
findings.detail: A future resolution of the same manifest may select different transitive artifacts.
findings.remediation: Commit a supported lockfile and verify every resolved artifact integrity.

findings.summary: npm publication workflow does not declare build provenance
findings.detail: The repository contains an npm publication path, but the reviewed workflow and publisher scripts do not enable `--provenance` or `NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true`. The next artifact may not carry a verifiable source commit and build workflow attestation.
findings.remediation: Enable npm provenance with `npm publish --provenance` or `NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true`; GitHub Actions publishers also need `id-token: write`, then inspect the next exact artifact with `inspect --deep`.
